request.prompt: A single hanging creature sprite for RimWorld, painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background. A mouth on a tendon: one bare muscular cord, pale reddish-pink with fine parallel fibrous muscle striations, hangs plumb and perfectly straight under its own weight, slack and still. The cord is one smooth, uniform-width, taut tendon running unbroken down to the jaw, with no scales, no torso, no limbs and no swellings, bulbs, knots or braided strands anywhere along its length. At its upper end sits a compact patch of dark Eyebark canopy: rough, gnarled brown-grey bark with a few small leaves, which the cord grows from. The cord's upper end flares into short root-like fibres that spread flat and outward and sink into the bark, bark tissue and cord tissue merging at one compact junction, so the cord is rooted directly into the canopy and reads as growing out of it. Below the junction the cord drops straight down without wrapping or coiling around any branch, and the canopy patch stays small so the hanging cord and jaw remain the dominant silhouette. The free lower end is only a jaw, hinged where the cord meets it, with no head behind it, no eyes, no skull shape and no neck; the creature is the cord and the jaw and nothing else, ending at the jaw with no tail tip. Front view, seen from the front: the heavy, wide-open toothed jaw dangles at the end of the cord with its opening hanging wide open toward the viewer, fangs ringing the dark mouth. Side view: the jaw in profile, opening to the side, cord straight above it. Rear view, seen from behind: the viewer sees the back of the hanging jaw, the outer rear surface, a closed, rounded mass of smooth muscle where the cord joins the jaw, with the mouth opening turned away from the viewer and hidden, and at most the tips of a few fangs peeking out at the lower edge; the toothed interior is not visible, and the cord runs straight down the center into this rounded rear. The subject fills the tall canvas, drawn at 1.7 x 1.7 tile size, reference: none.
